conditions.label: Baseline
conditions.description: Independent exponential nonnegative latents, constant class entropy, ReLU output, and AdamW weight decay 0.03.

conditions.label: Entropy SD 0.5
conditions.description: Class-dependent conditional entropy with across-class SD 0.5 nat and a bias-free readout.

conditions.label: Entropy SD 1
conditions.description: Class-dependent conditional entropy with across-class SD 1 nat and a bias-free readout.

conditions.label: Entropy SD 2
conditions.description: Class-dependent conditional entropy with across-class SD 2 nats and a bias-free readout.

conditions.label: Affine, entropy SD 0
conditions.description: Constant-entropy control with a readout bias, testing whether the affine head changes the baseline.

conditions.label: Affine, entropy SD 1
conditions.description: Class-dependent entropy SD 1 nat with the theoretically matched affine readout.

conditions.label: Affine, entropy SD 2
conditions.description: Class-dependent entropy SD 2 nats with the theoretically matched affine readout.

conditions.label: Copula rho 0.1
conditions.description: Weak conditional dependence from an equicorrelated Gaussian copula with unchanged exponential marginals.

conditions.label: Copula rho 0.3
conditions.description: Moderate conditional dependence from an equicorrelated Gaussian copula with unchanged exponential marginals.

conditions.label: Copula rho 0.5
conditions.description: Strong conditional dependence from an equicorrelated Gaussian copula with unchanged exponential marginals.

conditions.label: Gamma k=2
conditions.description: Non-exponential nonnegative Gamma conditionals with common shape 2 and class means matched to baseline.

conditions.label: Weibull k=1.5
conditions.description: Non-exponential nonnegative Weibull conditionals with shape 1.5 and class means matched to baseline.

conditions.label: Log-normal
conditions.description: Nonnegative log-normal conditionals matched to both the class-specific exponential means and variances.

conditions.label: Sign flips 0.1
conditions.description: Boundary test in which each exponential latent coordinate is independently sign-flipped with probability 0.1.

conditions.label: Sign flips 0.5
conditions.description: Fully symmetric signed-latent boundary test with independent sign-flip probability 0.5.

conditions.label: LeakyReLU 0.1
conditions.description: Activation-boundary test allowing negative outputs with LeakyReLU slope 0.1.

conditions.label: Linear
conditions.description: Activation-boundary test removing the nonnegative output constraint entirely.

conditions.label: Weight decay 0
conditions.description: Energy-regularizer removal with all other baseline settings fixed.

conditions.label: Weight decay 0.01
conditions.description: Intermediate energy-regularizer strength between removal and the 0.03 baseline.
